responsibility: Provides the implementation of GCC’s reusable RTL common-subexpression/value-numbering library used by multiple optimization passes. It maintains cselib_val objects, hash tables for RTL values and preserved constants, register and memory equivalence tracking, invalidation on sets/calls/clobbers, address-to-memory relationships, value expansion callbacks, and dumping support, giving clients such as DSE and CPROP a local symbolic value model over RTL that survives instruction scanning and selective invalidation.
same_name_distinction: Implements the cselib RTL value-tracking library declared in gcc/cselib.h. Unlike the header’s API and structure definitions, this source file contains the executable hash-table management, lookup/equality logic, insn scanning, register/memory invalidation, preserved-value handling, initialization/finalization, and dump routines behind that interface.
